title: Trinamool Congress announces Kolkata rally demanding CEC resignation

tea.why: Protesting against the suppression of democracy, police action in New Delhi, and the detention of party leaders.
tea.want: Demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
tea.changed: Oct 12: Trinamool Congress announced a rally in Kolkata scheduled for Tuesday.

summary: The Trinamool Congress faction led by Mamata Banerjee announced a protest rally in Kolkata, scheduled to take place on Tuesday from Rajabazar to Park Circus. The demonstration aims to demand the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Additional stated agendas for the march include protesting against the suppression of democracy, the detention of Mamata Banerjee in New Delhi, and the oppression of the opposition and new-generation protesters. The event route spans minority-dominated areas in the city. Meanwhile, state political figures criticized the planned mobilization, questioning whether police permission would be granted and accusing the party of attempting to disrupt the upcoming festive season.
demands: Resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar
End to the suppression of democracy
Protest against the detention of Mamata Banerjee in New Delhi
Halt to the oppression of the opposition and new-generation protesters
response: State leaders criticized the planned protest, claiming it would disturb the festive ambience before Durga Puja and questioning whether police permission would be granted for the route.

updates.text: The Trinamool Congress faction announced a mega rally in Kolkata for Tuesday, demanding the resignation of CEC Gyanesh Kumar.
